text:
mike: Quick sync 1: Customer (DeltaMed) asked for a 'spill-to-hosted' add-on during their pilot—no extra commit, billed only for spilled tokens. Need guardrails + launch criteria.

anya: Key ask: committed traffic must keep latency SLO; spilled requests can be best-effort. They also want spill metrics in Console per-route.

vikram: Runtime note: we can route overflow to hosted pool but must limit max_spill_percent and have deterministic triggers to avoid noisy neighbor impact.

cassie: Finance: we need a monthly minimum for any pilot using spill, and a clear billing text. Free goodwill window (up to 4h) okay.

financebot: Draft billing line: "Spill-to-hosted requests billed at on-demand rates, subject to a pilot minimum of $YYYY/month. Redwood may apply protective throttles under system stress."

anya: Legal wants a pilot carveout: "spill events during pilot won't be used to set baseline commit for 90 days" 1: customers push back on recalibration.

mike: Product proposal: route config `spill_policy` with fields `max_spill_percent`, `region_constraint`, `billing_mode`. Example: {"max_spill_percent":20,"billing_mode":"pass_through"}.

vikram: Triggers: start spill when committed queue > 70% for 3m OR CPU>80% for 5m; stop when both below 60% for 5m. Runbook to include exact thresholds.

cassie: Console: surface `spill.start`/`spill.end` events and a monthly spill tokens metric. Exports for finance if customer requests weekly CSV.

mike: Launch criteria: 1) eng spec + runbook, 2) sim showing <10% neighbor impact at 20% cap, 3) billing text + pilot addendum, 4) Console metric emitted.

anya: Action items: vikram -> spec PR and sim by Wed; cassie -> billing floor proposal by Tue; legal -> addendum draft by Thu. I'll own sign-off.

vikram: Noted. I'll post sim numbers and link ticket.

mike: Thanks everyone. We'll avoid baking exceptions into core TOS; pilot addendum only.
